name: AccessLog
purpose: Records every successful read of classified data with actor, purpose-of-use, and record identifier, distinct from the security audit log.
api_signature:
from typing import Protocol
from datetime import datetime

class AccessLog(Protocol):
    def record_read(self, actor: str, record_id: str, data_class: str, purpose_of_use: str, at: datetime) -> None: ...
    def query(self, record_id: str | None = None, actor: str | None = None) -> list[dict]: ...
    def count_by_actor(self, actor: str, since: datetime) -> int: ...
invariants: Every read of a PiiClassification-tagged record MUST emit one AccessLog entry before the response leaves the process.
purpose_of_use MUST be one of a registered set; ad-hoc free-text values SHALL be rejected.
AccessLog entries MUST NEVER be merged with the TamperEvidentAuditLog so high-volume read traffic cannot mask low-volume security events.
Actor MUST be a resolved identity (user, service account, or break-glass id); 'system' without a concrete id is FORBIDDEN.
Retention of AccessLog MUST follow a RetentionPolicy bound at registration; unbounded accumulation CANNOT occur.
extension_contract: Repositories wrap reads with an access-log interceptor that calls record_read. Custom purpose-of-use codes are added via register_purpose(code, description). Export adapters subscribe to the log to feed HIPAA accounting-of-disclosures reports.
consumption_example:
from datetime import datetime, timezone

def read_patient(access: AccessLog, actor: str, patient_id: str) -> dict:
    record = _repo_get(patient_id)
    access.record_read(actor, patient_id, 'phi', 'treatment', datetime.now(timezone.utc))
    return record

sources.locator: § 164.312(b) Audit controls — recording and examining access

sources.source: AICPA SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria (2017, 2022 revision)
sources.locator: CC6.1 — logical access to protected information

why_essential: Mixing reads into the security audit drowns anomaly detection and breaks HIPAA's accounting-of-disclosures requirement; a separate primitive keeps volumes, retention, and semantics distinct.
alternatives_considered: Single combined audit stream — hides security events under read noise and miscounts for 164.528 disclosures.
Database-level query logging — captures SQL not business actor or purpose_of_use.
HTTP access logs at the proxy — lacks record identity and data classification.
